## 4. Your choice

::: {.callout-note title="Answer key"}
**1.** (a) Athens: citizens voted in the Assembly (democracy); Sparta: two kings and a council of elders. (b) Athens: reading, writing, music, public speaking; Sparta: army training from age 7. (c) Athens: the navy, trade, plays and philosophy; Sparta: the army on land.

**2.** Both were Greek city-states; both spoke Greek; both honored the same gods; both went to the Olympic Games.

**3.** Only *a free man with Athenian parents*.

**4.** Any choice with two reasons from the lesson.
